name: illians_warrior
description: an Illians Warrior, a frost-pale northern barbarian: wild white hair and a white beard, bare chest and arms under a white wolf-fur pelt slung over the shoulder, ice-blue wraps on the wrists and shins, a blue belt with a steel stud over a ragged white fur kilt, grey fur boots, a pale grey club studded with ice-blue crystals raised in his RIGHT hand, and a round white shield with a studded steel rim and a blue snowflake on his LEFT arm
hands: the ice-studded club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round snowflake shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the ice-studded club is lifted beside the head with its crystal-studded head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the club's crystal-studded head hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round snowflake shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the club is level, its crystal-studded head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the club's crystal-studded head smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its crystal-studded head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the wild white hair and beard trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round snowflake shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round snowflake shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the club held up at the left, the round snowflake shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round snowflake shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's crystal-studded head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the white wolf fur under him; the ice-studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round snowflake shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks, the white hair settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the ice-studded club and the round snowflake shield on the ground beside him
